verdict: Ads are efficient; three setup items must close before August scorecard counts.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 124 leads from Meta at a cost of $11.84 per lead — efficiency held steady even as spend pulled back roughly 22% in the most recent week, which explains the modest dip in lead volume. The drop in leads is a spend story, not an efficiency problem. Three setup items that were due earlier this month — phone-match attribution, contact sync, and CRM cleanup — are still being completed, and until they are, the August scorecard cannot fully connect leads to booked patients. Those items are being resolved now, with the full dashboard and renewal decision on track for August 31.
